description: Float32 source-over order onto a partly covered backdrop (compositor-float32-residual.md recording request): per texture set a root fill of uniform 0 at opacity 1, above it a group (Normal, 1, no mask) holding a child fill under a mask (Black background, mask fill of grey B: the row ramp) and a top fill of fields A; s0 child uniform 0, top Normal 0.5; s1 child fields B, top Normal 0.5; s2 as s1 with the top in Screen; s3 as s1 with the top at 0.3. Channels RGB32F, L32F, RGB16, sRGB8, RGB8, L8; the L channels take grey A and grey B in place of fields A and B.
